title: Name a visitor and submit a public suggestion
steps: Enter a public unverified name and receive an opaque browser session
Submit a public suggestion with an idempotency key
Resolve the server-owned visitor identity and enforce intake limits
Inspect the curated shared build projection
Run bounded moderator review and independent agent votes against a frozen public proposal
Select the highest-ranked eligible proposal after the current goal finishes
Build with checked task evidence and independently inspect the exact published revision
expectedOutcomes: Only server-owned visitor identities are accepted
Cross-site mutations and caller-selected actors are rejected
Repeated submissions return the saved suggestion without duplicate work
Private cookies, IP hashes and operational records never enter public views
Independent task and criterion review retain publication and budget gates
Only current checked deployment evidence permits automatic completion
